If remaining is safe and no method connects, do not leave or cover the fire with soil; exclude people and burnable material and keep signalling. Only after no nearby heat is felt may wet ash and visibly unburnt wood be touched cautiously. Never touch coal, charred material or anything that may be hot. Current site rules control; Victorian fire-specialist, controlled live-fire and stressed-reader review remain outstanding.
